remarks: Attention Investors & Renovators! A prime corner-lot opportunity in Meadowlark Park — perfect for those looking to redevelop or build sweat equity. This bungalow offers undeniable potential for restoration or a fresh start, and is being sold as-is.  Situated in a mature west-end neighbourhood, the location delivers exceptional convenience: minutes from West Edmonton Mall, Misericordia Hospital, schools, parks, and easy transit connections. Whether you envision a full renovation, a modern infill, or a strategic investment, this property offers outstanding long-term value in one of Edmonton’s most established communities.  A rare chance to capitalize on location, lot size, and future potential. (id:67522)
